title: 1 man dead after being shot during confrontation with home invader, Toronto police say
summary: A man has died after a shooting during an attempted home invasion early Wednesday in Toronto, police say.

image.caption: A man is dead after he was shot during an attempted home invasion near Casa Loma in the early hours of Nov. 25, 2026, Toronto police said. (Paul Smith/CBC)

blocks.text: A man has died after a shooting during an attempted home invasion early Wednesday in Toronto, police say.
Police say the man, who died in hospital, was the homeowner's son
Emergency crews responded to a shooting at a residence near Poplar Plains Road and St. Clair Avenue W. around 2:48 a.m., said Toronto paramedics.
Toronto police believe the incident was an attempted home invasion, 53 Division Staff Sgt. Shain Griffin told CBC News.
He said a suspect was confronted by the homeowner's son, who was shot in the interaction.
Paramedics said a man was taken to hospital in critical condition. The son was later pronounced dead in hospital, Griffin said.

He said police do not yet have details on the number of suspects involved or any descriptions. Residents can expect a heavy police presence in the area as investigators canvass for evidence and video, he said.
Investigators with the homicide unit are looking into the case, Toronto police said on social media platform X.
